links.outcome: Reporting of study design, training sample size, and demographics in FDA device summaries
links.effect: Summaries failed to report study designs (323 [46.7%]), training sample size (368 [53.3%]), and demographic information (660 [95.5%]).
links.quote: Device summaries often failed to report study designs (323 [46.7%]), training sample size (368 [53.3%]), and/or demographic information (660 [95.5%]).

links.outcome: Proportion of cleared devices with randomized trial data or patient outcomes evidence
links.effect: Only 6 devices (1.6%) reported RCT data, 53 (7.7%) prospective studies, and patient outcomes in 3 (<1%).
links.quote: Only 6 devices (1.6%) reported data from randomized clinical trials and 53 (7.7%) from prospective studies.

links.outcome: Reporting of sensitivity and specificity performance metrics in premarket summaries
links.effect: Sensitivity reported for 166 (24.0%) and specificity for 152 (22.0%) devices.
links.quote: Few premarket summaries contained data published in peer-reviewed journals (272 [39.4%]) or provided statistical or clinical performance, including sensitivity (166 [24.0%]), specificity (152 [22.0%]), and/or patient outcomes (3 [<1%]).

links.outcome: Postmarket adverse events and recalls among AI/ML devices
links.effect: 489 adverse events involving 36 (5.2%) devices, including 458 malfunctions, 30 injuries, 1 death; 40 devices (5.8%) recalled 113 times, mostly software issues.
links.quote: A total of 40 devices (5.8%) were recalled 113 times, primarily due to software issues.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional empirical study auditing regulatory reporting and postmarket surveillance data (adverse events, recalls, safety reporting) for all FDA-cleared AI/ML medical devices.
